description: Manages git tags. Supports list (default), create, and delete actions. List returns structured tag data with name, date, and message. Create supports lightweight and annotated tags.

commit.description: Commit to tag (used with create action, default: HEAD)

create.description: Shorthand to create a tag with this name (sets action=create). Consistent with branch tool's create parameter.

merged.description: Filter to tags merged into HEAD (--merged)

message.description: Tag message for annotated tags (used with create action, triggers -a -m)

name.description: Tag name (required for create and delete actions)

noMerged.description: Filter to tags not merged into HEAD (--no-merged)

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

pointsAt.description: Filter tags pointing at a commit (--points-at)

name: tag
title: Git Tag
